reviewed_hunks.quote: Session length (quick or standard) and difficulty (gentle, standard or challenge) are user-selected in Settings and applied to the one-click start. Quick sessions rotate which two of the four mechanics appear, so repeated short sessions still cover all four; standard sessions keep the full interleaved lineup. The optional practice plan asks when and where the next session will happen, what to pair it with, and what to do if stuck; it is stored locally and never blocks starting.

reviewed_hunks.quote: Beyond Motivation mode the product stays deliberately quieter: an **opt-in adaptive difficulty** experiment (adjusts per-task level from recent accuracy, never marketed as superior), a **monthly word-recognition far check** on its own schedule and store (the app states up front that reviews usually find no transfer), and an **opt-in research-study enrollment** that tags sessions with the assigned trial arm. The session header shows the current block's level, and every result keeps that level so blocks can be compared within the same level; adaptive changes are visible in the session rather than silent. A copyable weekly summary and a JSON export cover accountability and portability without accounts.
